Form No. 2
G. 20,000-1-30

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTER
4383
H.Q. Crime Branch Station,
Date January 4th 1933.

Subject (in full) Cohn Trading Company

Made by D.S.I. Ovsiannikoff Forwarded by Supt. Quayle

Sir,
With reference to the attached memo I beg to report
that I located Mr. Cohn alias Cohen, British Jew, employed
by Baroukhs & Company at 317 Kiangse Road. It appears from
enquiries that the Cohn Trading Company was bought by Mr.
Baroukh as the latter company experienced a financial bank-
rupt and Mr. Cohn had not money to pay the Municipal tax on
his shop at 304 Kiangse Road. Mr. Baroukh when buying the
Cohn Trading Company also agreed to employ Mr. Cohn as a
shop assistant.

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently

V. Ovsiannikoff
D.S.I.

D.C. (Crime)

Mr Heaney Passport Office, H.B.M. Consulate
notified as above.

〔此处有签名及日期 5/1/33〕

FILE C 1314

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告

上海公共租界工部局警务处
S. B. 登记簿
4383
总部刑事科，
日期：1933年1月4日。

事由（全称）科恩贸易公司（Cohn Trading Company）

呈报人：副巡官奥夫相尼科夫（Ovsiannikoff） 转呈人：警司奎尔（Quayle）

先生：
关于所附备忘录，谨此报告，我已找到科恩先生（又名科亨，Cohen），其为英国籍犹太人，受雇于江西路317号的巴鲁赫公司（Baroukhs & Company）。经查询得知，科恩贸易公司系由巴鲁赫先生（Mr. Baroukh）买下，因后者公司遭遇财务破产，且科恩先生无钱支付其位于江西路304号店铺的市政捐税。巴鲁赫先生在收购科恩贸易公司时，亦同意雇用科恩先生为店员。

此致
敬礼

V. 奥夫相尼科夫（Ovsiannikoff）
副巡官

刑事科副总监

已按上述情况通知英国驻华领事馆护照办公室的希尼先生（Mr Heaney）。

〔此处有签名及日期 1933年1月5日〕
